title: HANFIS source record v2 (asset-week)
description: One row per image (asset) per ISO week. Supersedes anfis_source_schema.json: adds image_id, week_start_utc, reachability_level and version_range_status, puts threat_intelligence on the 0-1 scale, and records unknown as null rather than 0.

event_id.description: unique id of the asset-week row

week_start_utc.description: Monday 00:00 UTC of the observation week

cvss.description: x1, max CVSS base over affected and reachable CVEs; null = unknown

exploitability.description: x2, max EPSS(t) x rho over the same CVEs

patch_risk.description: x3, 0 not in range, 1 fix available not applied, 2 affected without fix

threat_intelligence.description: x7, external feed on 0-1 (v1 used 0-10; converted on ingest)

reachability_level.description: rho (A-01): 0 not installed or out of range, 0.1 installed no dependency, 0.25 transitive not activated, 0.6 loaded trigger unproven, 1 loaded and trigger available

version_range_status.description: deterministic comparison against Alpine secdb (primary) and CNA/NVD ranges (secondary)

y.description: temporal target y(a,t) from EPSS/KEV over a 30-day window; absent in feature-only rows

evidence_sha256.description: hash of the frozen evidence bundle for this row
